trails.name: Heart of Wales Line Trail
trails.why: Heart of Wales Line Trail is a long distance footpath, running 229 kilometres / 142 miles from Craven Arms to Llanelli.

trails.name: Sussex Border Path

trails.name: Wye Valley Walk

trails.name: Harcamlow Way

trails.name: Wessex Ridgeway

trails.name: Isle of Anglesey Coastal Path

trails.name: Fife Coastal Path

trails.name: Icknield Way Path

trails.name: Greensand Way

trails.name: Norfolk Coast Path

trails.name: Severn Way (3) Worcester to Bristol

trails.name: Two Saints Way

trails.name: Angles Way

trails.name: Tarka Trail

trails.name: Nidderdale Way
